# BataiBato

> BataiBato (बाटैबाटो) is Nepal's community driven ride sharing platform, starting from Sindhuli district.

## Core Pages
- [Home (Nepali)](https://bataibato.github.io/): Official landing page in Nepali with app overview, vehicle types, and download links
- [Home (English)](https://bataibato.github.io/en/): Official landing page in English
- [Features (Nepali)](https://bataibato.github.io/features/): Instant ride matching, fair fare splitting, GPS tracking, verified drivers, in app chat, scheduled rides
- [Features (English)](https://bataibato.github.io/en/features/): English features showcase
- [How It Works (Nepali)](https://bataibato.github.io/how-it-works/): Four step guide covering download, route selection, riding, and fair payment
- [How It Works (English)](https://bataibato.github.io/en/how-it-works/): English step by step guide
- [About (Nepali)](https://bataibato.github.io/about/): Mission, Sindhuli origin story, team, and Nepali community values
- [About (English)](https://bataibato.github.io/en/about/): English story and company mission
- [Download (Nepali)](https://bataibato.github.io/download/): Google Play Store link, QR code, app screenshots, system requirements
- [Download (English)](https://bataibato.github.io/en/download/): English download page
- [Contact (Nepali)](https://bataibato.github.io/contact/): Support email, phone numbers, and office in Sindhuli
- [Contact (English)](https://bataibato.github.io/en/contact/): English contact information
- [FAQ (Nepali)](https://bataibato.github.io/faq/): Common questions about rides, digital payments, safety, and accounts
- [FAQ (English)](https://bataibato.github.io/en/faq/): English frequent questions
- [Privacy Policy](https://bataibato.github.io/privacy/): Comprehensive GDPR and Nepal privacy compliance, data handling, and deletion instructions
- [Terms of Service](https://bataibato.github.io/terms/): Legal terms, user conduct, rider and driver obligations, and dispute resolution

## Key Facts
- Vehicle options: Motorcycle, Scooter, Auto Rickshaw, Car
- Launch district: Sindhuli, Nepal (Kamalamai, Sindhulimadhi, and surrounding routes)
- Target market: Commuters, students, tourists, and daily travelers across Nepal
- Mobile platform: Android via Google Play Store
- Package identification: com.bataibato.app
- Currency: Nepalese Rupee (NPR)
- Supported payment methods: Cash, eSewa, Khalti, and digital wallets
- Support contact: support@bataibato.com
